title: IF.EAGER evaluates both branches, so an error in the untaken branch is raised
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", IF.EAGER ( [Order Count] > 0, 1, ERROR ( "untaken branch" ) ) )

expected.error: IF.EAGER evaluates the else branch although the condition is TRUE, and it raises an error

source.quote: It uses an eager execution plan which always executes the branch expressions regardless of the condition expression.
even though we never return the Err variable, DAX needs to evaluate its value
source.supports: IF.EAGER is documented as equal to variables for the branches; a referenced variable holding ERROR fails

derivation: IF.EAGER ( c, a, b ) is documented as VAR t = a VAR f = b RETURN IF ( c, t, f ). The else branch is ERROR, which is evaluated although [Order Count] = 7 > 0, so the query fails. With IF the result would be 1.
